verdicts.reason: A blows the headline up into a three-line block that collides with confetti (red flag, purple and green stars, blue swirl over DIRTHDAY/PARTIES), jams 'EVENT MANAGMENT' into the canvas edge and on top of a swirl and the left owl, and leaves the blue owl shrunken and floating, so the hierarchy and calm composition are lost. B keeps the original composition: centred subtitle and two-line headline, owls framing both sides, clean contrast. Its only flaws are slight extra dead space under the headline and owls cropped at the edges the same way as in the original.
